name: Urza's pocket dimension
description: A hidden space made to look like Urza's cabin in the Ohran Mountains of Gulmany.

timeline.summary: Epilogue: Jodah casts a shock spell at the Starfield Orb and is pulled into a pocket dimension resembling Urza's cabin.
timeline.quote: In a blue flash, the world vanished

timeline.summary: Jodah meets constructs of Xantcha and Mishra, who accept him as a descendant of Urza.
timeline.quote: My name is Jodah, friend of Teferi's and descendant of Urza,

timeline.summary: Jodah realizes the place is Urza's failsafe, the Legacy, and plans to tell Teferi; Mishra relays Urza's final words about ending conflicts.
timeline.quote: This whole place—it's Urza's failsafe in case he perished before he could deploy it against the Phyrexians.

pages_say.description: A hidden space made to look like Urza's cabin in the Ohran Mountains of Gulmany.
